subject.title: Cron session accumulation can silently exhaust agent context window — no guardrails or warnings

question: Should this broad cron session accumulation issue remain the umbrella while the retention and cadence guardrail PRs are decided, or should maintainers split and close it around narrower canonical items?
rationale: Current main still has a real retention gap, but the requested warning/limit behavior changes operator-facing cron policy and overlaps open maintainer-reviewed PRs.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Keep this issue open until the active retention and cadence guardrail PRs are landed, replaced, or explicitly rejected, then close or split any leftover warning work.

options.title: Narrow To Retention Bug
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89666 the canonical retention item and create a separate follow-up for context-pressure warnings or cadence policy.

options.title: Close After Slice Decisions
options.body: Close this issue only after the slice decisions are recorded and no untracked guardrail behavior remains.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the active retention and cadence guardrail PRs are landed, replaced, or explicitly rejected, then close or split any leftover warning work.
